sentences.en: I use the microwave oven to heat up my leftovers.
sentences.zh: 我用微波炉加热剩饭剩菜。

sentences.en: Don't put metal objects in the microwave oven.
sentences.zh: 不要把金属物品放进微波炉里。

sentences.en: The microwave oven is perfect for quick meals during a busy week.
sentences.zh: 忙碌的一周里，微波炉是快速制作饭菜的好帮手。
